g.title:
1. Digital & Physical Customer Channels [Access Tier] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: The omnichannel engagement layer serving retail, SME, and corporate banking customers across native mobile apps, responsive web portals, feature-phone USSD (*XYZ#), merchant POS terminals, branch ATMs, and social messaging channels (WhatsApp/Webchat).
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Functions as the customer front door. It captures customer financial and non-financial intents, enforces device-level security (biometrics, 2FA, binary obfuscation), and securely routes traffic to cloud ingress or on-prem switching engines.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Retail Customers (iOS/Android), Corporate Treasurers (Web EV-SSL), Telco Subscribers (*XYZ#) • OUTBOUND: Huawei Cloud WAF & API Gateway (HTTPS 443), Telco Aggregators (SMPP 2775), Postilion Switch (ISO 8583 Port 9000) • FAILOVER: BGP Anycast DNS, multi-telco dual-SIM failover on POS/ATMs, multi-AZ cloud WAF ingestion. • SECURITY: GuardSquare DexGuard/iXGuard, FIDO2 biometrics, SafeToken 2FA, DUKPT PIN encryption, PCI-DSS Level 1 terminal certs. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)

Retail Mobile Banking App (iOS & Android) [Section 1: Customer Channels] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Native consumer mobile banking applications published on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store for daily retail banking operations.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Allows retail customers to register accounts, check balances, transfer funds via NIP, buy airtime/data, pay utilities, and manage debit cards from smartphones.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Retail Banking Customers via Touch/FaceID • OUTBOUND: Huawei Cloud WAF & Kong API Gateway via HTTPS / TLS 1.3 (Port 443) • FAILOVER: BGP Anycast routing to redundant Cloud WAF endpoints. • SECURITY: GuardSquare DexGuard & iXGuard binary code obfuscation, root/jailbreak detection, SSL pinning, and FIDO2 biometric authentication. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: App Store & Google Play Store Native Applications
• Ingress Target: Huawei Cloud WAF & Kong API Gateway

g.title:
Corporate & SME Internet Banking Portal [Section 1: Customer Channels] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Responsive enterprise web banking portal designed for commercial business accounts, SME managers, and corporate treasury departments.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Enables multi-tiered maker-checker workflows, bulk salary payroll processing, commercial FX purchases, trade finance letters of credit, and corporate statement exports.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Corporate Treasurers & SME Directors via Web Browsers • OUTBOUND: Huawei Cloud WAF & Corporate Ingress via HTTPS / TLS 1.3 (Port 443) • FAILOVER: Multi-region cloud web servers behind Cloud WAF and elastic load balancers. • SECURITY: Extended Validation SSL (EV-SSL), Content Security Policy (CSP), SafeToken hardware/software 2FA (Maxut), and dual-approval transaction limits. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Responsive Web Portal for Enterprise Treasury & Bulk
• Maker-Checker Workflow with Batch Payroll Ingestion

g.title:
USSD Banking Channel (*XYZ#) [Section 1: Customer Channels] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Interactive session-based USSD financial channel operating on feature phones without requiring internet access or smartphones.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Delivers financial inclusion across unbanked and semi-urban populations in Nigeria for rapid balance checks, airtime top-ups, and instant transfers.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Mobile Subscribers on MTN, Airtel, Glo, 9mobile dialing *XYZ# via Telco Aggregators • OUTBOUND: Calls Digital Banking Applications & API Gateway (Section 2) via REST over HTTPS / mTLS (Port 443) • FAILOVER: Multi-aggregator automated failover; redundant cloud API gateway endpoints with auto-scaling microservices. • SECURITY: Thales payShield 10K hardware HSM for PIN translation, ephemeral 90-second session state timeouts, and daily velocity transaction caps. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: • Protocol: REST over mTLS (Session translated from SMPP)

g.title:
POS & Agency Banking Terminals [Section 1: Customer Channels] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Fleet of Android SmartPOS and traditional Linux payment terminals deployed at merchant locations and agency banking kiosks across Nigeria.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Facilitates in-person card payments, merchant POS acquiring, cash-in/cash-out agency banking, and bill payments using debit/credit cards.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Cardholders inserting Verve, Mastercard, or Visa cards • OUTBOUND: Postilion Financial Switch & Interswitch via ISO 8583 over IPsec VPN (Ports 9000-9100) • FAILOVER: Multi-telco dual-SIM roaming (MTN/Airtel/Glo) on all POS terminals with sub-second failover. • SECURITY: DUKPT (Derived Unique Key Per Transaction) PIN encryption, PCI-PTS certified hardware, and Terminal Management System (TMS) remote key injection. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: • Connection: Dedicated APN SIMs (MTN, Airtel, Glo)
• Security: DUKPT PIN Encryption, TMS Remote Key

g.title:
Branch & Offsite ATM Fleet [Section 1: Customer Channels] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Multifunction cash dispenser and cash deposit automated teller machines (ATMs) deployed at bank branches, offsite shopping malls, and airports.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Provides 24/7 cash withdrawals, cash deposits, cardless ATM payouts, PIN changes, and mini-statement printing.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Cardholders inserting chip cards & inputting 4-digit PINs • OUTBOUND: Postilion Financial Switch via ISO 8583 over Shivtech Managed IPsec Routers (Port 9000) • FAILOVER: Dual cellular SIM wireless backhaul (Shivtech) backed by branch metro fiber. • SECURITY: Triple-DES (3DES) / AES PIN pads, Cencon digital vault locks, anti-skimming sensors, and physical CCTV DVR recording. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: • OEM: NCR / Diebold Nixdorf with Cencon Locks
• Network: Dedicated Dual SIM IPsec VPN (Shivtech)

g.title:
Social Channels & Conversational AI [Section 1: Customer Channels] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Conversational banking gateway connecting official WhatsApp Business accounts, Facebook Messenger, and website live chat with AI chatbots and live agents.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Allows customers to interactively query balances, transfer money, purchase airtime, and escalate complex disputes to Contact Center call center agents.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Customers messaging official bank WhatsApp Business account (+234...) • OUTBOUND: Huawei Cloud CCE Notification & Chat Services via Webhook HTTPS (Port 443), Avaya CCaaS Contact Center for live agent handoff • FAILOVER: Meta Cloud multi-region API infrastructure with redundant webhook endpoints. • SECURITY: End-to-end encryption via WhatsApp Business API, OTP verification for financial actions, and secure tokenization of customer identities. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: WhatsApp Business Banking, Webchat, Social Bots
• WhatsApp Business Cloud API (Meta Official Partner)
• Omnichannel Bot: Avaya Social / Infinite Gold
• Target: Huawei Cloud CCE Notification & Chat Microservices

g.title:
IAM / 2FA Auth Suite (SafeToken & iToken) [Section 1: Customer Channels] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Hardware and software multi-factor authentication (MFA) suite supplied by Maxut Consulting Limited for identity verification.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Enforces second-factor challenge-response tokens during internet banking logins and high-value transactions, preventing credential stuffing and unauthorized fund movement.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Customer Portal Logins and Transaction Authorization requests • OUTBOUND: Identity & Auth Microservice on Huawei Cloud via REST API (Port 443) • FAILOVER: Dual-datacenter authentication server redundancy; software push notification fallback to SMS OTP. • SECURITY: Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) algorithm, cryptographic hardware seed encryption, and Microsoft Entra ID role federation. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: • Protocol: TOTP / Push Notification / Hardware OTP
